mapper.sql: SELECT r.id AS r_id, r.task_id AS r_task_id, r.task_item_id AS r_task_item_id, r.athlete_id AS r_athlete_id, r.indicator_id AS r_indicator_id, r.model_id AS r_model_id, r.session_key AS r_session_key, r.measure_date AS r_measure_date, r.attempt_no AS r_attempt_no, r.is_valid AS r_is_valid, r.is_selected AS r_is_selected, r.invalid_reason AS r_invalid_reason, r.data_source AS r_data_source, r.raw_payload AS r_raw_payload, r.create_by AS r_create_by, r.create_time AS r_create_time, t.task_name, a.name AS a_name, a.gender AS a_gender, d.dept_name, ind.code AS ind_code, ind.name AS ind_name, ind.evaluation_direction AS ind_direction, ind.unit AS ind_unit, m.code AS mdl_code, m.name AS mdl_name, ti.item_type, ti.sort_order AS item_sort FROM apms_test_result r LEFT JOIN apms_test_task t ON r.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN apms_task_item ti ON r.task_item_id = ti.id LEFT JOIN apms_athlete a ON r.athlete_id = a.athlete_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.primary_team_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN apms_indicator ind ON r.indicator_id = ind.id LEFT JOIN apms_test_model m ON r.model_id = m.id
mapper.select:
r.task_id = #{taskId} AND r.athlete_id = #{athleteId}
ORDER BY r.task_item_id, r.attempt_no

r.task_item_id = #{taskItemId} AND r.is_selected = '1'
ORDER BY r.athlete_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_test_result (task_id, task_item_id, athlete_id, indicator_id, model_id, session_key, measure_date, attempt_no, is_valid, is_selected, invalid_reason, data_source, raw_payload, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{taskItemId}, #{athleteId}, #{indicatorId}, #{modelId}, #{sessionKey}, #{measureDate}, #{attemptNo}, #{isValid}, #{isSelected}, #{invalidReason}, #{dataSource}, #{rawPayload}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE apms_test_result SET task_id=#{taskId}, task_item_id=#{taskItemId}, athlete_id=#{athleteId}, indicator_id=#{indicatorId}, model_id=#{modelId}, session_key=#{sessionKey}, measure_date=#{measureDate}, attempt_no=#{attemptNo}, is_valid=#{isValid}, is_selected=#{isSelected}, invalid_reason=#{invalidReason}, data_source=#{dataSource}, raw_payload=#{rawPayload} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE apms_test_result SET is_selected=#{isSelected} WHERE id=#{id}
